다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?
A: I'm going on a trip to Mexico.
B: <u>Take care on your trip!</u>

I hope you have a safe trip.
Don't forget to bring your passport.
I want to go to Mexico someday, too.

다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?

B: They ②look nice. If you go to the US, which of these places would you like to visit?
G: ③I'd like to visit this place to see the famous statue and take pictures of the city.
B: That ④sounds fun!
G: I agree! ⑤I've already been there one day.

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
① A: I'm going to Vietnam next week. B: That sounds amazing! I hope you have a great time.
② A: I want to visit the White House one day. B: Me too. I hope we can go there together.
③ A: I bought a lantern for the festival. Let's make a wish! B: Okay. I hope my family is always healthy.
④ A: I will run in a 10-kilometer race tomorrow. B: I hope you win the race.
⑤ A: I hope our wish comes true. B: I have a lot of things to do these day.

questions.promptEn:
[04~06] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
G: What are you looking at?
B: I'm looking at pictures of Japan. I'm going to go there with my family.
G: That's great. What do you want to see there?
B: We want to see traditional places like the one in this picture. We're planning to stay in a traditional house, too.
G: That sounds amazing! ⓐI hope I can go there someday.

04 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 의미가 같은 문장을 모두 고르면?
choices: I would like to go there sometime.
I don't want to go there anymore.
I wish to visit the country one day.
I hope I can travel somewhere this year.
I believe there's no chance for our wish.

G: What are you looking at?
B: I'm looking at pictures of Japan. I'm going to go there with my family.

G: That sounds amazing! ⓐI hope I can go there someday.
choices: 소년은 혼자 일본 여행을 갈 계획이다.

Q. Where is the boy's family planning to stay in Japan?
G: What are you looking at?
B: I'm looking at pictures of Japan. I'm going to go there with my family.
G: That's great. What do you want to see there?
B: We want to see traditional places like the one in this picture. We're planning to stay in a traditional house, too.
G: That sounds amazing! ⓐI hope I can go there someday.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ send away bad luck. ((답지 P160R Dialog 심화 문제 pp.82-83 07)
questions.promptEn:
[07~11] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
W: We're finally here, the lantern festival in Thailand!
B: There are already a lot of people here.
W: Yes. I'm excited to see the bright lanterns in the sky.
B: Me too! But why do people fly lanterns?
W: People ⓐbring bad luck with the lanterns and make wishes.
B: That's interesting!
W: Yes. I bought a lantern for us, too. Let's make a wish!
B: Okay. I'd like to wish for our family's happiness.
W: That's a wonderful wish. Are you ready to fly our lantern? 3, 2, 1, go!
B: Wow, it's beautiful. ⓑ저는 우리의 소원이 정말로 이루어지기를 바라요.
